title: Centaur
extract:
The Centaur is an Archmelee with a powerful six-hit combo complemented by its high attack speed and high critical chance to supplement its low damage.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Slash damage.
No delay between combo looping, allowing for smoother attacks.
Innate  polarity.
Advantages over other Archmelee   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
High crit chance (25.00%)
Very high attack speed (1.080x animation speed)
High damage × attack speed (507.6)
High attack range (142.50 m)
High status chance (20.00%)
High crit multiplier (2.00x)
Disadvantages over other Archmelee   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Very low total damage (376)
See WARFRAME Wiki:Stat Comparison/Percentiles for more details.

Acquisition
The Centaur's blueprint can be purchased from the Market. Its parts can be purchased from various Syndicates. All parts, except for the blueprint, are tradeable.

Tips
Centaur can utilize  Tempered Blade to greatly increase its critical chance up to 62.5%, providing an additional 30% overall DPS.

Trivia

A Centaur is a mythological creature that is half-human, half-horse.
Incidentally, there is a species of Rhinoceros beetle called the Centaurus beetle. The Centaur's blade resembles a Rhinoceros beetle's characteristic horn while the body of the weapon resembles the beetle's head.
The Centaur (along with the  Fluctus and the Itzal) was accidentally leaked in Hotfix 15.6.1 (2014-12-11), where a bundle called the "Itzal Raider Pack" visually replaced the Stealth Pack in the Market. The Stealth Bundle still functioned as normal however.
